blurb: The Academy offers dance classes including ballet, tap, jazz, hip-hop, and modern dance, gymnastics classes focusing on tumbling and acrobatics, and musical theatre classes that develop acting, singing, and dancing skills. They emphasize proper technique, confidence building, and life lessons such as responsibility and teamwork. The studio holds several performances annually and has a successful competitive dance group.
